changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: actions.metadata was seeded with snake_case keys (guidance_link, available_area_type) in db.changelog-1.81.xml, inconsistent with the camelCase convention used everywhere else in API responses. Renames those keys in place to guidanceLink and availableAreaType for any rows that already have metadata set.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE actions SET metadata = ( (metadata - 'guidance_link' - 'available_area_type') || CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(metadata, 'guidance_link') THEN jsonb_build_object('guidanceLink', metadata->'guidance_link') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END || CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(metadata, 'available_area_type') THEN jsonb_build_object('availableAreaType', metadata->'available_area_type') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ) WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND (jsonb_exists(metadata, 'guidance_link') OR jsonb_exists(metadata, 'available_area_type'));
